note: One interactive demo per island. status 'live' = working reference in site/demos.js; 'spec' = build it from this description. Every demo runs in the browser with no server, no API key and no model download, unless 'needs' says otherwise.

demos.title: Is it AI, ML or just rules?
demos.does: Sort 8 everyday systems (spam filter, calculator, chess engine, chatbot, thermostat, photo search…) into Rules / Machine learning / Deep learning / LLM by dragging cards into bins.
demos.shows: The difference between AI, ML, deep learning and LLMs, and that 'AI' is a spectrum, not magic.
demos.build: Drag-and-drop with keyboard alternative (select card, then press 1-4). Reveal an explanation per card on drop. Score at the end.

demos.title: Python in your browser
demos.does: Edit and run 4 tiny Python snippets (variables, a loop, a function, a dict) and see the output live. Then fix a broken one by reading its traceback.
demos.shows: Code is just instructions you can read, run and change; a traceback tells you exactly which line broke.
demos.build: Pyodide from cdn.jsdelivr.net/pyodide (≈10 MB, load on click, show progress). Monaco or a plain textarea with mono font. Pre-written snippets, a Run button, an output panel.

demos.title: Gradient descent, step by step
demos.does: Watch a line fit noisy points. Change the learning rate, press Step or Run, drag points around and see the loss curve react.
demos.shows: A model learns by following the slope of its error downhill; too small a learning rate is slow, too big overshoots and diverges.
demos.build: Canvas: points, current line, loss-over-steps sparkline. Plain JS math, no libraries.

demos.title: Overfitting you can see
demos.does: Slide polynomial degree from 1 to 12 and resample the noise. Training error keeps falling; validation error drops then climbs.
demos.shows: Why you hold out validation data, and what overfitting and underfitting look like.
demos.build: Canvas: train points (filled), validation points (hollow), fitted curve, two error bars. Least squares via normal equations, plain JS.

demos.title: A tiny neural net learns a spiral
demos.does: Pick 1–3 hidden layers and 2–16 neurons, press Train and watch the decision boundary bend to separate two spirals.
demos.shows: Layers of simple units can learn shapes a straight line never could; more capacity learns faster but can overfit.
demos.build: Small MLP with manual backprop in JS (like TensorFlow Playground), heatmap on canvas, 60 fps training loop paused off-screen.

demos.title: Temperature and the next word
demos.does: Type a prompt start, see a toy model's top next words as probability bars, move the temperature slider and sample 10 times.
demos.shows: An LLM predicts likely next tokens; temperature reshapes the odds, from predictable to creative to nonsense.
demos.build: Toy distribution table (no real model), softmax with temperature, animated bars, a sample button that streams words.

demos.title: Ask the documents
demos.does: Ask a question about a 6-page mini handbook. See which chunks retrieval picks, their similarity scores, and the cited answer.
demos.shows: RAG = find the right passages first, then answer only from them, with citations.
demos.build: Precomputed embeddings for ~40 chunks (ship as JSON) and for ~20 sample questions; cosine similarity in JS; answers are templated from the top chunk. Label it as a simulation.

demos.title: Agent loop, visible
demos.does: Give an agent a task ('find the cheapest flight and add it to my calendar'). Step through Think → Call tool → Read result → Think until done; break a tool to see it recover.
demos.shows: Agents are a loop of reasoning and tool calls, and most of the engineering is in the tools and error handling.
demos.build: Scripted trace (JSON) with branching on 'tool fails'; timeline UI with expandable tool-call JSON.

demos.title: Be the eval
demos.does: Grade 12 model answers as pass/fail, then compare your grades with an LLM-judge's grades and see where you disagree.
demos.shows: Evals start from real examples and human judgment; automatic judges must be checked against people.
demos.build: Static dataset of answers + judge labels, agreement % and a confusion matrix.

demos.title: Open model picker
demos.does: Set your laptop's RAM/GPU and a task; see which open-weight model sizes fit, at what quantization, and roughly how fast.
demos.shows: Parameters × bytes per weight = memory; why 7B runs on a laptop and 70B doesn't.
demos.build: Calculator with sliders; formula shown under the result. Cite the formula, don't invent benchmarks.

demos.title: LoRA: tune a few knobs
demos.does: Toggle between full fine-tuning and LoRA on a big weight grid; drag rank r from 1 to 64 and watch trainable parameters and memory change.
demos.shows: LoRA freezes the big matrix and trains two thin ones, so you update ~1% of the parameters.
demos.build: SVG matrix diagram (W ≈ W + B·A), live parameter counter.

demos.title: Which answer is better?
demos.does: Pick the better of two answers for 8 prompts. Your choices train a tiny reward model; then see how it ranks new answers.
demos.shows: Preference tuning learns from comparisons, not from correct labels; reward models copy your taste, including your biases.
demos.build: Bradley–Terry on 3 hand-made features (length, politeness, correctness flag) in JS; show learned weights.

demos.title: Quantization slider
demos.does: Drag precision from 16-bit to 2-bit and watch a sample image/weight histogram get coarser, memory drop and a quality score fall.
demos.shows: Quantization trades a little quality for a lot of memory and speed, and it breaks down at very low bits.
demos.build: Quantize a real image's pixel values as a stand-in for weights; show memory maths for a 7B model alongside.

demos.title: Backprop by hand
demos.does: Change inputs and weights in a tiny computation graph (a·b + c, then tanh); press Backward and watch gradients flow node by node.
demos.shows: Backpropagation is the chain rule, applied from the output back to every input.
demos.build: SVG graph like micrograd's, values and grads on each node, animated edges.

demos.title: Attention heatmap
demos.does: Hover any word in a sentence to see which earlier words it attends to, across 4 heads.
demos.shows: Attention lets each token look back at the tokens that matter for it.
demos.build: Precomputed attention weights from a small model for 5 sentences (JSON); heatmap rows highlight on hover.

demos.title: Build a tokenizer
demos.does: Press Merge to run byte-pair encoding on a paragraph one step at a time and watch frequent pairs become new tokens.
demos.shows: Tokenizers are learned from data; common chunks become single tokens.
demos.build: Real BPE in JS on a short text, a merge table, token count dropping step by step.

demos.title: Scaling-law explorer
demos.does: Choose model size and training tokens on log sliders; see predicted loss and compute cost, and find the compute-optimal point.
demos.shows: Bigger models need more data; there's a best size for a given compute budget.
demos.build: Plot the published Chinchilla fit (Hoffmann et al., 2022) with its constants cited; log-log canvas chart.

demos.title: See like a convnet
demos.does: Pick a photo and a filter (edges, blur, sharpen, custom 3×3) and watch the convolution slide across it; stack two layers.
demos.shows: Convolutions detect local patterns; stacked layers build bigger features.
demos.build: Canvas pixel ops in JS on 3 public-domain images from this library.

demos.title: Boxes and masks
demos.does: Toggle detection boxes, segmentation masks and labels on a painting from the atlas; adjust the confidence threshold.
demos.shows: Detection says what and where; segmentation outlines each pixel; thresholds trade misses for false alarms.
demos.build: Precomputed boxes/masks for 3 paintings (JSON/PNG), opacity animations, threshold slider.

demos.title: Words as points
demos.does: Explore a 2D map of 300 words; click one to see its nearest neighbours; try king − man + woman.
demos.shows: Embeddings turn words into numbers where similar meanings sit close together.
demos.build: Precomputed 2D projection + 50-d vectors (GloVe, PDDL licence) for 300 words; cosine search in JS.

demos.title: Same sentence, five tasks
demos.does: Paste a short invoice-like text and switch between tasks: classify, extract fields, summarize, translate, answer a question.
demos.shows: One pretrained transformer can be fine-tuned for many language tasks.
demos.build: Scripted outputs for 4 sample texts (label 'example output'); optional real model via transformers.js if the user opts in.

demos.title: Walk the latent space
demos.does: Drag a point across a 2D latent grid and watch a tiny decoder morph one image into another.
demos.shows: Generative models learn a smooth space where nearby points decode to similar images.
demos.build: Precomputed grid of 10×10 decoded images (sprite sheet) from a small VAE; interpolate between cells.

demos.title: Noise to picture
demos.does: Scrub a timeline from pure noise to a finished painting and back; change the number of steps.
demos.shows: Diffusion learns to remove noise a little at a time.
demos.build: Precomputed frames of a denoising run on a public-domain painting (sprite or WebP sequence), scrub slider.

demos.title: Teach a robot to cross the grid
demos.does: Watch a Q-learning agent explore a 6×6 grid with a goal and pits. Change the reward and exploration rate; see the value map update.
demos.shows: Agents learn from reward by trial and error; exploration vs exploitation.
demos.build: Tabular Q-learning in JS, arrows per cell, value heatmap, speed control.

demos.title: Policy learns to balance
demos.does: Train a policy-gradient agent on CartPole in the browser and plot the reward curve; compare a random policy.
demos.shows: Deep RL learns behaviours from reward alone, and training is noisy.
demos.build: CartPole physics in JS + REINFORCE with a tiny network; canvas render.

demos.title: Design the system
demos.does: Drag blocks (data source, feature store, training, registry, API, monitor) into a pipeline and see what breaks when one is missing.
demos.shows: A model is a small part of an ML system; the rest is data, deployment and monitoring.
demos.build: Snap-to-slot board with validation messages; keyboard support.

demos.title: Drift alarm
demos.does: Watch live predictions stream on a dashboard; push a 'season change' button and see input drift, accuracy fall and an alert fire.
demos.shows: Models decay in production; monitoring catches it so you can retrain.
demos.build: Simulated data stream, two sparklines and a threshold alert.

demos.title: Risk sorter
demos.does: Place 10 AI failure scenarios on likelihood × severity axes, then compare with how researchers rate them.
demos.shows: Different risks need different responses; reasonable people disagree on how likely each is.
demos.build: Drag on a 2D grid; reveal sourced references after placement. Keep it balanced; cite sources.

demos.title: Look inside a neuron
demos.does: Click neurons in a toy network trained on simple shapes to see which inputs make them fire most.
demos.shows: Interpretability looks inside models to find features they actually use.
demos.build: Precomputed activations for a small CNN on 200 tiny shapes; top-activating examples per neuron.
